messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: High token and request surge observed on /v1/embeddings-edge from multiple IP clusters. Error rate rising to 5%. Paging oncall.

maria (oncall): on it. initial ask: is this targeted to embeddings-only or broader?

nishit: looks embeddings-heavy. Spike concentrated on /v1/embeddings-edge and async-batch. Large bursts from ~1500 IPs, same UA patterns.

samir: seeing huge fanout from a small set of API keys + proxy IP ranges. rate per key ~200/s sustained, embedding size ~2048 dims, cost blowup.

olivia (support): any customer-facing impact? Any tenants hitting errors?

maria (oncall): yes — a handful of customers see 502s and degraded latency for embeddings. CX queue flagged 3 tickets.

samir: suggest tactical mitigations: 1) apply geo-slice on suspicious regions, 2) temporarily reduce max_concurrency for embeddings-endpoint, 3) enable WAF signature for the UA fingerprint.

edge-security: I can push a WAF rule to tarpit/302 for matching UA regex and block known proxy ASNs. Want approval to roll immediately.

maria (oncall): approve WAF tarpit for matching UA and immediate ASN block for top 10 offending ASNs. Samir, enact rate-slice now.

samir: doing rate-slice. command:```/ops rate-slice create --route /v1/embeddings-edge --slice suspicious --limit 20rps --match 'ua:/Scrapex|MimicBot/i'```

deploy-bot: rate-slice created: id=rs-2026-4823, applied to edge fleet in region eu-west and us-east.

maria (oncall): also lowering per-key burst to 10 rps for embeddings. This will kick active abusive sessions while giving real customers some headroom.

nishit: starting a temporary kill switch on async-batch to prevent fanout amplification. Command:```/ops service disable --name embeddings-async-batch --reason 'mitigation - scrape amplification'```

deploy-bot: embeddings-async-batch disabled on edge nodes.

olivia (support): drafting customer notice: short blurb explaining we observed abusive traffic that temporarily impacted embeddings latency; we applied mitigations. Will update tickets.

maria (oncall): need to monitor KPIs: 1) request rate to /v1/embeddings-edge 2) 5xx rate 3) avg latency p95. Samir, can you surface dashboard and a 5-min alert if 5xx > 1%?

samir: dashboard link: https://console.redwood/internal/d/embeddings-edge-mitigation. Alert rule created: alerts/emb-edge-5xx.

edge-security: WAF tarpit active. Early impact: 60% drop in matched UA traffic, 30% drop in overall fanout. Still seeing distributed client IP list switching via proxies.

maria (oncall): next step: enforce short-lived dynamic quota for new keys from those ASNs: 50 tokens/min per key. Samir please roll.

samir: applied dynamic quota policy: dq-4823, enforced for matching ASN list and removed async batch.

olivia (support): customer update draft: "We've applied blocking and rate-limiting measures to mitigate automated requests affecting embeddings. If you see reduced throughput please reply and we'll escalate. No data exfiltration detected."

maria (oncall): good. Post that to flagged customer tickets. Also flag legal if any account shows credential stuffing patterns.

nishit: I've pulled a sample of keys showing token churn; some are legitimate customers behind CDNs — creating false positives. We'll need a whitelist path.

maria (oncall): create an emergency whitelist flow: verified customer support tickets -> allowlist ids -> bypass rate-slice. Olivia coordinate.

olivia (support): will collate affected account IDs and post to #support-allowlist.

samir: live numbers: overall request rate down 48%, embedding token/sec down 62%, 5xx down from 5% -> 0.8%. Latency p95 improving but still elevated in eu-west.

maria (oncall): good trend. Keep WAF + rate-slice for another 60m, then reassess for rollback. Assign followups:
- samir: validate that dynamic quotas aren't affecting normal customers (monitor CX tickets).
- nishit: iterate on UA regex to reduce collateral.
- olivia: notify impacted customers and collect allowlist requests.
- edge-security: prepare permanent WAF signature to push after review.

edge-security: noted. We'll generate a hashed UA signature and ASN denylist to add to nightly deploy if confirmed.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollback check at +60m: job id rb-4823.

maria (oncall): if 5xx rises again or token/sec spikes > +20% baseline -> re-escalate pager. For now, holding mitigations.

samir: one more: we've started capturing full request headers for matched traffic to support detection ML training. Will store for 72h per privacy rules.

olivia (support): tickets updated. Customers of note: cust-A and cust-B saw elevated errors; both acknowledged the notice.

maria (oncall): thanks team. I'll update incident tracker and mark this as live-mitigation ongoing. Handoff: maria -> nishit in 30 mins.

nishit: ack. Will take next oncall.

incident-bot: Incident update recorded: severity=sev2, mitigation=rate-slice+WAF+tarpit+quota, assigned=maria,nishit, samir, edge-security, olivia. Thread closed by oncall for monitoring.
